reserved empty area (priority 1, x=20%-80%, y=20%-80%): keep only a soft, uncluttered backdrop surface here (light, texture, depth) — a real product photo will be composited into this area later; no objects
supporting visual mass (priority 3, x=10%-90%, y=75%-85%): Texto secundário próximo ao the reserved empty space para reforçar a mensagem.
